jobs.description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 

Job Posted: September 21, 2026



Hi there!

We're looking for a Finance Manager to be the dedicated finance partner for Zapier's marketing organization. This is a unique opportunity to own the full financial picture for one of the most strategically important spend areas at the company - headcount, budget, and channel investment while playing a key role in connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes. You'll report into the Head of GTM Finance and partner closely with marketing leadership, working closely with Sales FP&A and Corporate FP&A to establish a clean interlock between marketing, sales, and company level financials.

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

 - Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/


ABOUT YOU

 - This isn’t your first rodeo. You have 4-6+ years of accounting/finance-specific experience, with 2+ years of working with Marketing or GTM orgs. A background in Big 4 Accounting, Investment Banking, or Management Consulting with meaningful ownership of operating expense areas

 - You're comfortable owning a budget end to end, including headcount, spend actuals, and purchase orders, and communicating variance clearly to non-finance stakeholders

 - You have a strong grasp of channel-level marketing economics (pipeline generation vs. brand), cost per pipe, and how to connect spend to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity - able to structure a loosely-defined problem yourself rather than needing it handed to you fully scoped

 - You have good judgment and a bias toward surfacing issues and opportunities proactively, not waiting to be asked

 - You actively use AI tools to work more efficiently, with the judgment to know when to go deep manually and when to lean on the tool

 - You're a strong written and verbal communicator, able to turn a complex analysis into a short, clear executive takeaway with guidance from your manager

 - Experience with Google Sheets, a data warehouse (Databricks or Snowflake), NetSuite, Zip, and HubSpot is preferred




THINGS YOU’LL DO

 - Own marketing FP&A end-to-end: headcount planning, budget building, and actuals tracking, so marketing leadership always has a clear, current view of where things stand against plan

 - Own channel allocation analysis (demand generation vs. brand) and drive ROI-by-channel reporting

 - Work on sales pipeline forecasting based on spend, as part of setting GTM targets and ARR modeling, flagging risks to pipeline coverage or targets early

 - Serve as an embedded business partner to marketing leadership - not a once-a-month reporting function, but someone marketing trusts to think through decisions with in real time

 - Track purchase orders and vendor commitments against budget, flagging overspend risk before it happens

 - Analyze the connection between marketing spend, pipeline generation, and closed-won revenue, working cross-functionally with Sales and RevOps

 - Partner with the Data team to establish and govern pipeline reporting definitions (leads, MQLs, opportunities) so the funnel is consistent end to end

 - Use AI to automate recurring finance processes, building skills and agents that can run parts of month-end close and re-forecasting cycles


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

Job Posted: 09/22/2026

Location: USA & Canada

Level: IC4 & IC5



Hi there!

Zapier’s mission is to make automation and AI accessible to everyone. Our enterprise customers are adopting automation as a strategic capability, not just a tool. They need expert partners who can help them orchestrate processes, unlock new use cases, and scale their impact.

We’re looking for an Automation Strategist to join our Customer Success organization as the core role working with customers on our enterprise plan. This role blends strategic advisory, orchestration design, and value-focused relationship expansion. As an Automation Strategist, you will help customers shape their automation strategy, identify and deploy high-value use cases, and guide them toward meaningful AI-enabled transformation.

This role moves beyond classic Customer Success, focusing on consulting, systems thinking, orchestration, executive alignment and continuous value discovery, rooted in our team’s mission of delivering value through clarity, impact, curiosity, and approachable expertise.

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

 - Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/




ABOUT YOU

 - You see opportunity in ambiguity and building things that scale
   
   - You experiment, learn quickly, and iterate openly, unafraid to make, and revise, bets.
   
   - You enjoy creating playbooks as much as running them.
   
   - You appreciate that each customer is unique, yet you build frameworks that scale across them.
   
   - You use AI in your work today — not occasionally, but as part of how you operate at a high level. You can point to workflows you’ve built, how your approach has evolved through iteration, and the impact on quality, efficiency, and experience — while intentionally applying AI for the right outcomes, setting a high bar for outputs, and taking ownership of what ships.

 - You’re a strategic, customer-centric problem solver.
   
   - You’re relentlessly focused on the outcome and willing to learn new approaches or challenge the status quo to deliver value for our enterprise customers.
   
   - With 5+ years in SaaS (customer success, consulting, solutions, enterprise product or similar process and system strategy roles), customers see you as a valuable extension of their team
   
   - You have thoughts on how modern businesses should operate, including where inefficiencies hide and how automation + AI unlock leverage.
   
   - You can operate across audiences, from executive sponsors to execution teams running sprint-style projects.

 - You connect business goals to product solutions
   
   - You’re skilled at discovering what customers actually need (not just what they say),
   
   - You communicate automation value in terms of ROI, efficiency, scalability, and risk reduction
   
   - You think in systems, logic, and orchestration frameworks, but don’t get bogged down in technical details.
   
   - You own the outcome, project managing stakeholders internally (TAM, product, support) and externally (customer execution teams, Line of Business Leaders) to deliver realized, quantifiable value.

 - You’re an exceptional communicator
   
   - You communicate strategy and insights with clarity, empathy, and precision.
   
   - You know when to use async vs. live to balance ideal outcomes and speed, employing Slack, email, workshops, executive briefings, texts, and standups.
   
   - You leverage automation and AI yourself to execute with clarity, speed, and alignment..

 - Data guides your decisions.
   
   - You interpret usage patterns, account signals, and customer behavior to inform strategy.
   
   - You collaborate with data science and RevOps to shape MVP → mature data products and workflows.
   
   - You combine early data signals with strong first principles thinking to make decisions and evaluate progress.

 - You embody our cultural anchors
   
   - You lead customer engagements with clarity, dependability, approachable expertise, focusing on delivery meaningful value.
   
   - Internally you exercise good judgement and demonstrate our values of collaboration with purpose, accountability, recognition.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Guide Customers’ Automation Strategy
   
   - Build deep relationships that uncover goals, challenges, and priorities.
   
   - Advise on automation governance, best practices, and cross-functional program structure, process and design.
   
   - Help customers set goals and adopt AI-orchestrated processes across lines of business.

 - Discover and Deploy High-Value Use Cases
   
   - Identify impactful automation opportunities through exec alignment, influencer mapping, and citizen-developer input.
   
   - Work with customer stakeholders, SAs and TAMs to co-design implementation patterns that ensure scalability and long-term success.
   
   - Translate business problems into orchestration strategies that deliver measurable value.
   
   - Capture the prior state and descriptive metrics that help you quantify the impact of the work.

 - Drive Customer Outcomes
   
   - Demonstrate ROI and unlock new value paths through expanded automation usage.
   
   - Accelerate renewal and expansion by deepening customer maturity and outcomes.

 - Collaborate Across Zapier
   
   - Partner with Sales, Support, Product, and others to deliver a unified customer experience.
   
   - Share insights that influence roadmap decisions, positioning and GTM strategy

 - Build a World-Class Program
   
   - Help scale the methodologies, frameworks, and assets that define automation strategy at Zapier.
   
   - Do the best work of your life as we build Zapier for Enterprise from a subset of the business to the default choice of enterprises globally




HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We’re looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.


Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.
After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Hi there!

Zapier is looking for a People Business Partner with experience supporting GTM functions and employment standards in EMEA.

This role is for an intermediate to senior level People Business Partner who will own their portfolio end to end, with support from people team partners: organizational design, workforce planning, talent reviews, manager capability, performance, and complex employee situations.

Our People Business Partner and Employee Relations team currently holds deep expertise in Canadian and US employment practice, and we are deliberately hiring to broaden that. Experience advising on performance, exits, and complex employee matters across multiple EMEA countries is a core requirement.

As a member of the PBP-ER Team, you will also contribute to the effectiveness of how the team works using AI-enabled systems, and automation to make processes and day-to-day work more efficient and scalable. You don't need to be the team's AI expert, but you work in an AI-forward manner by default. 

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

ABOUT YOU

 - You have 5+ years of experience as an HRBP or PBP, and are capable of working autonomously in a global team.

 - You have experience with a varied set of client groups. GTM experience is an asset, but the role will flex across different client groups.

 - You’re unfazed by a fast moving environment, and can stay flexible and solutions focused in ambiguous situations, or in time where priorities may change

 - You build strong relationships and credibility with experienced stakeholders in order to coach them through HR challenges in their orgs, while balancing what is best for the individuals and the business.

 - You are capable of being a trusted sounding board and partner to your leaders in matters of organizational design, workforce planning, talent reviews, and change management. Leaders don't just need you to facilitate; they value your perspective.

 - You have advised and coached leaders on performance management, employee relations, and exits in multiple EMEA jurisdictions and can work collaboratively with employee relations partners and internal legal counsel through the process.

 - You use AI in your day-to-day work for personal productivity and for sharper insight and analysis across your portfolio.

 - You work effectively in a fully remote, distributed environment, and can flex across timezones when the work requires it.

 


THINGS YOU’LL DO

 - Serve as the strategic People partner to leaders in Data and Product, and the team expert in EMEA HR Partner Experience.

 - Develop deep knowledge of Zapier's market context, business strategy, and your client group's role within this to better advise and build strong relationships with your leaders.

 - Work directly with leaders in your organization on organizational design, setting and holding performance standards, talent reviews, and change management communications

 - Advise on complex people challenges, offering thoughtful, timely support that balances empathy with sound judgment and business context.

 - Act as the driver for PBP-led people processes within your client group, including performance review and promotion cycles, and engagement surveys.

 - Partner with Centers of Excellence to design and roll out people initiatives that are useful, relevant, and well-connected to the needs of the business.

 - Strengthen the team's practice outside North America by partnering with the PBP-ER team on any EMEA employee performance cases or investigations.

 - Continue to grow your skills in leveraging AI tooling for your day-to-day work, and sharing your practices with the team.
